text:
emily: bringing zaffre-compact-v1 into staging for embeddings smoke. want to run semantic sim + clustering + recall@k on a sampled wiki+qa corpus. kicking off a 5k sample now, pt jobs are up.
kai: nice. baseline for comparison?
emily: using beacon-base-v2 (768d) as the reference. zaffre is 512d, smaller footprint. main concerns: short-query recall and cluster purity.
raj: curious about quantization plans — int8 only for the first pass?
lina: yes, int8 post-train quant. also trying int4-perchannel in a separate run but will expect degradation.
emily: quick results from the 5k sample (int8):
```
Recall@1: zaffre 0.68 | baseline 0.74
Recall@5: zaffre 0.86 | baseline 0.89
Recall@10: zaffre 0.92 | baseline 0.94
Silhouette (kmeans 50): zaffre 0.21 | baseline 0.27
Avg cluster size stdev: zaffre 12.3 | baseline 10.1
```
kai: hmm recall drop at @1 is a bit concerning but @5/@10 acceptable. silhouette drop suggests more overlap — maybe embedding norming needed?
raj: can you share sample failing examples for recall@1? short queries usually the worst.
emily: pasted 3 short failures below (query -> top1 predicted):
- "refund policy" -> returns "billing limits" (should be billing refund)
- "nearest airport" -> returns "city population"
- "faq login" -> returns "password complexity"
seems semantic fine but fine-grained specificity off.
lina: try adding L2-normalization before kNN and rerun. also test cosine vs dot. default indexing was raw dot with IVF.
kai: re-run with `index: ivf_flat, metric: cosine`, batchsize 64 microbatch, kv-cache enabled. I'll spin it up.
evalbot: automated eval run queued: job_id=job_2026_03_22_001; sample=5k; configs=[zaffre-int8-cosine, zaffre-int4-rawdot, beacon-base-int8]. ETA ~ 8m.
raj: also worth checking UMAP projection for cluster overlap, sometimes int reductions compress certain semantic axes.
emily: attached quick UMAP snapshot link: https://staging-figs/zaffre_5k_umap.png (look at cluster 7/12 overlap)
kai: run finished for cosine config. quick numbers:
```
Recall@1: 0.71
Recall@5: 0.88
Recall@10: 0.93
Silhouette: 0.245
```
kai: improvement after cosine norming. Looks like metric mismatch was the main thing.
lina: int4 run still worse: recall@1 0.62, @5 0.83. could be per-channel calib mismatch. we'll hold int4 for heavy compression experiments only.
emily: thanks — plan: document these runs in the model onboarding checklist, promote zaffre-int8-cosine to canary with 10% traffic using fallback policy -> beacon-base on recall regressions. i'll open a PR for rollout config.
raj: +1. add a small promptset to monitor short query recall specifically.
emily: will do. ping me if you see a cluster with centroid drift >0.08 between staging and canary.
kai: noted. :thumbsup:
emily: anything else? otherwise i’ll close the smoke thread and start rollout PR.
lina: nothing else from infra. suggest a quick perf check for p50 latency with batchsize 32 after canary.
emily: added to checklist. thanks all. :party:
